Olive, burgundy, navy, black; Pantone from 500 pcs

sections.heading: The Box That Replaces the Gift Bag
sections.text: Statement Formats The Box That Replaces the Gift Bag Long-format gifts — bottles, roses, rolled textiles, tall diffusers — usually get boxed, then bagged. This format merges the two: a rigid elongated body with a load-tested satin handle rated for the contents, so the box itself is carried out of the store. The interior is lined in metallic silver or gold paper that reflects light back onto the product at opening. Handle anchors are riveted through double-board — not glued ribbon that pulls free with a 1.5kg bottle inside. Olive, burgundy, navy and black are stocked; sizes are cut to content length. For round bottles the cylinder tube is the sibling format; wine-specific programs live on the wine & spirits page .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions How much weight can the handle carry? Handles are riveted through double-board anchors and load-tested to your declared content weight — a 1.5kg bottle is the standard test case. Can it hold glass safely? Yes, foam cradles steady bottles and diffusers; combined with the rigid body the format passes courier drop tests when specced with content weight. What lengths are possible? Length is tooled to your content — from 300mm bottle formats to 600mm long-stem boxes — so nothing rattles in headroom. Which colours are stocked? Olive, burgundy, navy and black; any Pantone wrap from 500 pcs. What is the MOQ? 200 pcs, samples in 3–5 business days.
